attribution: Custom Definitive vector artwork reconstructed against the original Legend of Dragoon addition-name sprite alphabet. Original game design attribution Sony Computer Entertainment; extraction, semantic mapping and metric conventions Severed Chains contributors. Unmodified page/crops remain private.
authoringMethod: 65 individually composed family-native M/L/Q/Z skeletons and dedicated rectilinear features; offline headless Java2D expansion serializes filled quadratic contours. Crop controls constrained before preview rendering. No host font, Default139 reuse, bitmap contour tracing, staircase upscale or raster output in this public candidate directory. Source-exact control geometry is separately declared.
sourceCallSites: Battle.asciiTable_800fa788 semantic prefix66, with R/Q source order
Battle.getCharDisplayWidth exact width-adjustment array and unknown index0 fallback
BattleUiParts.queueLetter retains12x12quads; no per-character clipping/scissor in these local call sites; broader renderer state not audited here
visualLimits: Independent acceptance of source fidelity, stroke/counter spacing and tiny-scale legibility is still required.
Static Java2D rendering and CPU additive phrase simulations do not establish game/GPU/live palette, animation, Steam Deck or runtime selection acceptance.
Source-exact space/fallback control patterns may be visible in diagnostic CPU blend; actual native palette/transparency semantics remain runtime-owned.
